title: The corkboard's new pin
logline: The corkboard with one new thing on it since 2021: a photo of the ramp with the pup on it, taken on a phone and printed at the drugstore, pinned by a hand that isn't his. The inventory grows by one; the page records it.

panels.composition: A crowded corkboard with a new glossy drugstore photo print of a plank ramp with a small three-legged dog on it pinned at the edge, the older items around it faded.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a crowded corkboard with a new glossy photo print of a plank ramp and a small three-legged dog pinned at its edge among faded older items, no words legible
image.notes: Corkboard inventory +1 (2022): the ramp photo. Add to objects.md.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
